test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following pairs of thermal power plants and their locations is NOT correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Talcher – Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Neyveli** Thermal Power Plant is located in Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Panki** Thermal Power Plant is located in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• **Korba** Thermal Power Plant is located in Chhattisgarh.
 
• **Talcher** Thermal Power Plant is actually located in Odisha, not Assam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thermal Power Plants:**

 
 
• A thermal power plant is a power station where heat energy is converted to electric power. In most of the places in the world, the turbine is steam-driven.
 
• Water is heated, turns into steam, and spins a steam turbine which drives an electrical generator.
 
• After it passes through the turbine, the steam is condensed in a condenser and recycled to where it was heated; this is known as a Rankine cycle.
 
 
 
• **Neyveli Thermal Power Plant:**
 
 
• It is one of the largest thermal power stations in India and is located in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is run by Neyveli Lignite Corporation Limited (NLC).
 
 
 
• **Panki Thermal Power Plant:**
 
 
• Located near Kanpur in Uttar Pradesh, it is an important source of electricity for the state.
 
• It is operated by Uttar Pradesh Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Ltd (UPRVUNL).
 
 
 
• **Korba Thermal Power Plant:**
 
 
• Located in Korba, Chhattisgarh, it is one of the major power plants in the state.
 
• It is operated by National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC).
 
 
 
• **Talcher Thermal Power Plant:**
 
 
• Located in Talcher, Odisha, it is operated by NTPC.
 
• It is one of the oldest thermal power plants in India.
